description: Defines the DisplayMode class and related types for managing display configurations in Android's surfaceflinger service, including builder pattern for creation, comparison operators, and utility functions.

classes.name: DisplayMode
classes.description: Represents a display mode configuration including resolution, refresh rate, DPI, and grouping.

classes.name: DisplayMode::Builder
classes.description: Builder pattern class for constructing DisplayMode instances.

methods.name: DisplayMode::getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the display mode.

methods.name: DisplayMode::getHwcId
methods.description: Returns the hardware configuration ID associated with the display mode.

methods.name: DisplayMode::getResolution
methods.description: Returns the resolution of the display mode.

methods.name: DisplayMode::getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width component of the resolution.

methods.name: DisplayMode::getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height component of the resolution.

methods.name: DisplayMode::getFps
methods.description: Returns the frames per second (refresh rate) of the display mode.

methods.name: DisplayMode::getVsyncPeriod
methods.description: Returns the Vsync period in nanoseconds.

methods.name: DisplayMode::getDpi
methods.description: Returns the DPI (dots per inch) of the display mode.

methods.name: DisplayMode::getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group number for seamless mode switching.
